title: GIG-3363: Postmaclone Shared DB Connect
description: Adds postmaclone connect/disconnect for the nightly shared anonymized DB (SSH tunnel or direct egress), wires ngramx up --anon and Codabyte auto-connect, and addresses Bugbot review feedback (skip fresh on review --anon, tunnel cleanup, cross-platform PID lookup).

test_plan.description: Unit tests for connect service, UpCommand anon/trusted egress, and SSH tunnel helpers
steps: Confirm tests pass including test_it_connects_shared_db_on_trusted_egress_without_anon_flag and test_it_rejects_anon_with_postmaclone

test_plan.description: Local postmaclone connect dry-run and status
steps: In an app with postmaclone.shared configured, run ngramx postmaclone connect --dry-run
Run ngramx postmaclone doctor and confirm shared DB checks appear
After a successful connect, run ngramx postmaclone status and confirm IDE host/port and disconnect hint
Run ngramx up --anon in a project with postmaclone.shared configured
Confirm .env DB_* and docker-compose.override.yml point at the shared DB before containers start
Run ngramx down and confirm shared DB disconnect runs when the stack was started with --anon

test_plan.description: Bugbot fixes: review --anon safety, tunnel lifecycle, direct IDE endpoints
steps: Run ngramx review GIG-xxxx --worktree --anon (or worktree --anon) and confirm no fresh/migrate runs against the shared DB
Run ngramx postmaclone connect on macOS or Linux and confirm background tunnel succeeds or falls back to lsof PID lookup; disconnect restores .env even if the tunnel process already exited

test_plan.description: Live tunnel disconnect waits for port release after SIGTERM
steps: Run ngramx postmaclone connect then ngramx postmaclone disconnect without --force and confirm .env restores and lock clears while the tunnel is still up
